title: Well-founded accessibility R as the key invariant for constructive indefinite ground description over nat
intent: Reduce the constructive description (exists n : nat, P n) -> {n : nat | P n} to the accessibility of 0 for the relation R (x = S y /\ ~ P y): the key invariant that turns 'P holds somewhere' into 'the linear search from 0 terminates'. The parent glues the two directions of that equivalence (existence -> acc 0, and acc 0 -> witness) into one Defined proof.

parent.name: constructive_indefinite_ground_description_nat_Acc
parent.statement:
Theorem constructive_indefinite_ground_description_nat_Acc :
  (exists n : nat, P n) -> {n : nat | P n}.

children.name: P_eventually_implies_acc_ex
children.statement: Corollary P_eventually_implies_acc_ex : (exists n : nat, P n) -> acc 0.
children.closed_by: apply P_eventually_implies_acc with (n := x); replace (x + 0) with x; auto

children.name: acc_implies_P_eventually
children.statement: Theorem acc_implies_P_eventually : acc 0 -> {n : nat | P n}.
children.closed_by: well-founded recursion via Fix_F R; destruct (P_decidable x); the ~P x branch closes with IH y Ryx

applicability.goal_shape: A goal of the form (exists x : A, P x) -> {x : A | P x} (Prop-existence to Type/sigma-existence) over a decidable predicate on a natural-indexed domain, where eliminating the Prop existential directly is blocked because the goal is in Type.
applicability.use_when: the domain supports a linear search (a decidable P over nat or a countable domain) and you want the search's termination certified by a well-founded relation; the key invariant (here acc 0 = Acc R 0) has two directions that can each be proved separately and then glued.
applicability.avoid_when: you want a directly executable linear-search program and accept the longer, more ad-hoc direct development (the file's 'Direct version' section, lines 110-295, programs the search as prog_linear_search over the ad-hoc before_witness predicate, and is far longer than the Acc section at lines 301-369); P is not decidable; or you need only the Prop-level existence and not the computational witness {x : A | P x}.

metrics.how_counted: line spans of the parent and child sites (declaration + proof + Defined) from the copied file; depth is the chain parent -> P_eventually_implies_acc_ex -> P_eventually_implies_acc -> P_implies_acc checked by hand (lines 362-367, 340-344, 331-338, 325-329)

consequences: The move splits the goal into the two directions of an equivalence through the key invariant acc 0, each a lemma that must close on its own. The acc 0 -> witness direction is the only place decidability of P is used (Fix_F branches on P_decidable). The whole argument rests on R being well-founded: here R is 'step to successor when P fails', so Acc R x holds exactly when P holds somewhere at or after x; if R were not well-founded the accessibility hypothesis would be unprovable.
